test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the Eleventh Five Year Plan, artisans related to_______ were supported by the 'Marketing Support and Services Scheme'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**handicrafts.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marketing Support and Services Scheme**

 
 
• Marketing Support and Services Scheme’ (in the Eleventh Plan) supports artisans related to handicrafts.
 
• This scheme was implemented in the five-year plan.
 
• Its aim was to provide direct marketing outlets to the craft persons for participation in various marketing events for augmenting their sales.
 
• This scheme has three broad components:
 
 
• Domestic Marketing
 
• International Marketing
 
• Publicity
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-year plans**

 
 
• **Joseph Stalin** was the first person to implement the Five-Year Plan in the Soviet Union, in the year **1928.**
 
• India launched a series of Five-Year Plans after independence to build its economy and attain development
 
• The idea of five-year plans is simple- The Government of India prepares a document with all its income and expenditure for five years.
 
• There are total **12 five-year plans**.
 
• The budget of the central government and all the state governments is divided into two parts:
 
 
• **non-plan budget**
 
• **plan budget**
 
 
 
• The non-plan budget is spent on routine items yearly.
 
• The planned budget is spent on a five-year basis as per the priorities fixed by the plan.
